text: Hong Kong will require covered crypto providers to collect customer transaction information starting in 2027. The tax department begins international information exchanges under CARF in 2028. via CryptoSlate #HongKong #Crypto
Arkham blockchain data shows a wallet linked to Trump Media sent a $342M bitcoin transfer to Crypto.com. via CoinDesk #Bitcoin #Crypto
Crypto liquidations totaled $974.8M over 24 hours as bitcoin rose 4.6% to $80,480. Most losses hit traders betting on declines, per Coinglass. via BeInCrypto #Bitcoin #Crypto

Amundi, Europe's largest asset manager, has tokenized an equity index fund on Ethereum. The new share class gives blockchain-based exposure to an index covering 600 companies across European markets. via Cointelegraph #Ethereum #RWA

Ripple-backed XRP treasury firm Evernorth has dropped nearly 47% since its October Nasdaq listing. A new filing shows 73.7 million shares holders could resell, raising concerns about selling pressure. via BeInCrypto #XRP #Crypto

Thailand's SEC has filed a criminal complaint against BG Limited, operator of Bitget, over alleged unlicensed trading from 2022 to 2025. A planned access block is set for Dec 5. via Bitcoin Magazine #Bitget #Thailand

Greece Passes Crypto Tax Law with 10% Gains and 15% DeFi Levies
via Bitcoin.com News

US Treasury's FinCEN has ordered US institutions to stop all transfers to and from crypto exchange MEXC, which Treasury says facilitated $16B in illicit finance tied to Iran, North Korea and Russia. via Decrypt #Crypto #Regulation

Bitcoin Trails Restaurant Chain Stocks Over Six Months
via BeInCrypto
EU sets up a crypto task force within a new sanctions office to stop sanctions evasion using digital assets, including the A7 network's digital ruble stablecoin. via Bitcoin.com News #EU #Crypto

Total value locked in the Sky protocol fell 15% over the past week, while USDS circulating supply declined to $5.59 billion. Sky.money lists a 3.80% savings rate set by governance. via The Defiant #DeFi #Stablecoins

The crypto market briefly added about $100 billion after the U.S. midterm elections, then gave those gains back as Bitcoin and XRP fell amid a global tech stock sell-off. via Bitcoin.com News #Bitcoin #Crypto

Bitcoin dropped below $74,000 late Sunday, touching $73,708, its lowest since August. Ethereum fell to $2,100, and CoinGlass recorded $855.69M in liquidations over 24 hours. via BeInCrypto #Bitcoin #Crypto

Threshold says the tBTC bridge has resumed onchain, but its app remains paused. An Aave tBTC reserve on Ethereum is still frozen as more operators are expected to reconnect. via The Defiant #tBTC #DeFi

Vitalik Buterin faces a US lawsuit alleging the Ethereum Foundation fired a cancer patient who led an internal staff revolt. The case is tied to the Ethereum 'suicide pledge' row. via BeInCrypto #Ethereum #Crypto

Bitcoin is trading under $75,000 ahead of October US inflation data. Analysts say a lasting recovery would need better liquidity and spot ETF demand, not just short-term macro relief. via CoinDesk #Bitcoin #BTC

Ether, Solana and XRP fell as $580M in liquidations hit. Solana traded under $82 and XRP under $1.05 on Coinbase spot markets, while Bitcoin extended its decline below $73,000. via The Defiant #Crypto #Bitcoin

Total stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion, the steepest contraction since 2022. USDT and USDC together dropped nearly $11 billion over the past month, while gold-backed tokens stayed flat. via The Block #Stablecoins #Crypto

Bitcoin Core developers fixed three bugs, including a serious one that could stop miners from building new blocks. The flaws involve denial-of-service and privacy issues, not theft of coins. via Decrypt #Bitcoin

Bitcoin is on track for two consecutive years of losses, which would be its first such stretch and break a long run of annual gains. The data has some nuance, per the report. via Decrypt #Bitcoin #Crypto
